{{Top|leg}}
'''White wings''' was the name given to the set of bolt-on wings made early on in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They allowed [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] to launch themselves into battle. These add-ons were considered by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] the worst piece of equipment provided by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], due to their prone to failure and difficultness to use. Because of their [[white]] color, they were easy to spot in the air.
